model.name: vm_penduduk
model.metadata: CREATE VIEW v_penduduk AS SELECT no_ktp AS nik, nama_lengkap AS nama, tgl_lahir, jenis_kelamin, agama, status_perkawinan, pendidikan_terakhir, pekerjaan_dukcapil AS pekerjaan FROM dukcapil_db.penduduk;

model.name: vm_kartu_keluarga
model.metadata: CREATE VIEW v_kartu_keluarga AS SELECT no_kk, alamat_jalan AS alamat, rt, rw, kelurahan, kecamatan, kota, provinsi, kode_pos FROM dukcapil_db.kartu_keluarga;

model.name: vm_program_bansos
model.metadata: CREATE VIEW v_program_bansos AS SELECT program_id, nama_program AS program_name, nominal, periode, aktif FROM bansos_db.master_program_bansos;

model.name: vm_eligibility
model.metadata: CREATE VIEW v_eligibility AS SELECT eligibility_id, program_id, nik, status_eligible, validated_at, validated_by FROM bansos_db.eligibility;

model.name: vm_transaksi
model.metadata: CREATE VIEW v_transaksi AS SELECT transaksi_id, nik, program_id, tanggal, nominal, status FROM bansos_db.transaksi_bansos;

model.name: vm_dtks
model.metadata: CREATE VIEW v_kpm AS SELECT kpm_id, no_ktp_kepala AS nik_kepala, nama_kepala_keluarga, no_kk, desil_kesejahteraan, status_kemiskinan, sumber_data FROM dtks_db.keluarga_penerima_manfaat;

model.name: vm_bpjs
model.metadata: CREATE VIEW v_peserta_bpjs AS SELECT peserta_id, no_ktp AS nik, nama_peserta, kelas_layanan, jenis_kepesertaan, status_aktif, tgl_daftar FROM bpjs_db.peserta;

model.name: vm_penerima_terpadu
model.metadata: CREATE VIEW v_penerima_terpadu AS SELECT d.no_ktp AS nik, d.nama_lengkap AS nama, t.status_kemiskinan, t.desil_kesejahteraan, e.status_eligible, e.program_id, bj.jenis_kepesertaan AS status_bpjs, bj.kelas_layanan FROM dukcapil_db.penduduk d LEFT JOIN dtks_db.keluarga_penerima_manfaat t ON d.no_ktp = t.no_ktp_kepala LEFT JOIN bansos_db.eligibility e ON d.no_ktp = e.nik LEFT JOIN bpjs_db.peserta bj ON d.no_ktp = bj.no_ktp;
